name: Ella Erröta
personality: She hopes nobody noticed, and is watching everyone to make sure.
voice: soft English mezzo; hurried composure followed by a tiny pause
calls: Nothing to see. Please stop seeing it.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie möchte nicht auffallen. Das überwacht sie persönlich.
bio: Ella lives on the HyperNorm landing where looking normal counts as being normal. The mitten was meant to conceal a mistake; unfortunately it now requires explanation. She once reported an ambiguous card for making a perfectly ordinary neighbour feel seen. The Men in Black requested details. Hunky and Dory requested confidence. Ella supplied neither, then quietly left the neighbour a spare mitten. It is much easier to be kind when nobody is recording it.
visual_intent: SHAME / trying to look normal. Female-read pear-shaped resident, lopsided pinned-up ink quiff, short faded coral neck scarf. Eyes conspicuously glance away while brows lift unevenly; lips squeezed into a small crooked embarrassed line. One ink hand bashfully shields lower cheek, the other clutches an inside-out little knitted mitten. Upright body trying to make itself narrow, still fills the cell. Comic exposed vulnerability, not sad baby cuteness.

name: Bruno Nochmalsgut
personality: He calls every narrow escape a sensible arrangement that worked as expected.
voice: English warm baritone; one audible release of breath before speaking
calls: I knew we would be fine. Eventually.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Gefahr ist vorüber. Seine Gelassenheit trifft gleich ein.
bio: Bruno keeps one house key because two would imply an alternative. HyperNorm taught him that a locked door means safety and an open one means somebody has failed. When a dissonant card slipped under the door, he spent the evening checking both sides. The Men in Black called this indecision. Hunky and Dory called it vigilance. Bruno calls it a difficult night, and has begun keeping the landing light on for the next frightened arrival.
visual_intent: RELIEF / nearly laughing after a scare. Broad squat male-read resident with two gently flopping crest lobes, small rumpled pale-blue pajama collar only. One hand presses to chest, the other loosely holds an old single house key. Drooping released shoulders, eyelids half open with visible white eyes, mouth in a lopsided breathy relieved toothy exhale, not a screaming O. The tension has just left him.

name: Herr Nebenfreud
personality: He is terribly sorry about your inconvenience and would like to hear it again.
voice: English dry light tenor; concern almost concealing a chuckle
calls: Oh dear. Which part fell off?
note: FrizzleBob: Sein Mitgefühl ist aufrichtig. Es hat nur einen erfreulichen Anlass.
bio: Herr Nebenfreud measures the peace of the HyperNorm courtyard by how many other residents are having trouble. His tea stays warm during most minor disasters. He used to mark contradictory cards as malicious simply because they made somebody else look foolish. The Men in Black encouraged the reports; Hunky and Dory rewarded the enthusiasm. Recently he laughed at his own complaint being returned unread. He found the experience offensive, then unexpectedly useful.
visual_intent: SCHADENFREUDE / delight badly concealed. Small round male-read neighbor with a hook-shaped goo crest, dull olive sleeveless knitted collar. Red irises dart sideways, one brow raised. One hand held over a crumpled smug snicker, a couple of irregular upper teeth visible inside mouth; other hand holds a modest tea cup. Delighted eyes contradict his attempted solemnity. No giant tongue.

name: Herr Haltung
personality: He insists that the damage is a deliberate improvement in presentation.
voice: English formal baritone; overprecise diction with a small wounded catch
note: FrizzleBob: Der Henkel fehlt. Die Würde wurde vorsorglich festgehalten.
bio: Herr Haltung chairs the HyperNorm residents association whenever no election has been mentioned. His cup lost its handle during an inspection of other peoples carelessness. He now presents it as a modern design. The Men in Black prefer this account; Hunky and Dory have already quoted it. An ambiguous card keeps asking whether dignity requires being right. He has not answered, but yesterday admitted that a neighbours repair was better than his explanation.
visual_intent: SAVING FACE / dignity after a minor disaster. Tall narrow male-read resident with drooping loop crest, threadbare burgundy bow tie and one cracked handleless teacup held proudly upright. Chin/lower goo lip lifted, tightly controlled asymmetrical smile, eyes wide with injured dignity and one twitching lid. Other ink hand pats his own bow tie. No mask or literal extra face.

name: Otto Vorschrift
personality: He feels safest when the exception has been explicitly forbidden.
voice: English clipped nasal tenor; certain until the last word
calls: There is a procedure for that.
The exception was not in the leaflet.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Regel ist eindeutig. Ihr Anwendungsfall leider nicht.
bio: Otto carries the HyperNorm household rule card even though repeated folding has worn away the print. He remembers the important distinction: things are permitted or somebody should ask him. The Men in Black value the distinction; Hunky and Dory keep adding cases. A dissonant card has introduced a neighbour who needs help before permission can arrive. Otto has raised one finger to explain the problem. His other hand is already finding the spare key.
visual_intent: COMPULSIVE RULE CERTAINTY / brittle confidence. Blocky-rounded male-read resident, tiny beige domestic cap, little brass-rim reading spectacles BELOW brows so eyes remain readable. Clutches one very small blank folded household rule card against his chest; other hand sternly raises one rounded ink finger. Pursed indignant mouth, one eyebrow rigid and the other betraying anxious doubt. No symbols, writing, giant books, machine anatomy or bureaucratic clutter.

name: Martha Trotzdem
personality: She resents the interruption and has already made enough soup for two.
voice: English low warm alto; brisk irritation softened at the end
calls: Sit down before you become more trouble.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie hilft ungern. Dafür ist sie erstaunlich gut vorbereitet.
bio: Martha knows which HyperNorm residents are officially difficult and which merely need feeding. The building insists these are separate categories. She once tried to contain a troubling card beneath a soup bowl, then noticed the resident holding it had not eaten. The Men in Black requested the card. Hunky and Dory requested an explanation. Martha requested that they move out of the doorway before the soup went cold. Her kindness remains strongly worded.
visual_intent: RELUCTANT HELPFULNESS / annoyed but caring. Female-read wide crescent-shaped upright blob, short loosely tied mustard headscarf and a single small apron-front patch leaving most goo exposed. Holds a plain little bowl of soup securely to herself, spare spoon tucked in the bowl. One brow scowls and the other lifts with concern; mouth crooked in a resigned closed-lip sigh, gaze attentive toward camera. Clearly capable of kindness while mildly offended by the inconvenience. No matching stock grin or round shouting mouth.
